parameters.name: Brotli
parameters.description:
Brotli compression. Value range:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: Configuration ID. It can be obtained by calling the [ListCompressionRules](~~ListCompressionRules~~) interface.

parameters.name: Gzip
parameters.description:
Gzip compression. Value range:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- To match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- To match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Value range:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. A smaller numeric value indicates higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.

parameters.name: Zstd
parameters.description:
Zstd compression. Value range:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-compression-rule --site-id 54074984130000 --config-id 352816096980000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --brotli on --gzip on --zstd on --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateCompressionRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 54074984130000 --Zstd on --RuleEnable on --Brotli on --Gzip on --ConfigId 352816096980000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --Sequence 1 --RuleName rule_example
